kids.t: Your review is published with your account name and helps other travellers choose.
How would you rate your experience?
What stood out, good or bad? Think about the welcome, cleanliness, value and location.
Keep it honest and about your own visit. Don't include phone numbers or personal details. The business can reply publicly, and SafariNexa may hide reviews that break the guidelines.
